1.1: Rabbi eliezer omer, egla, bat shenatah. ufara, bat shetayim. vachachamim omrim, egla, bat shetayim. ufara, bat shalosh o vat arba. rabbi meir omer, af bat chamesh. keshera hazzekena, ella sheen mamtinin lah, shemma tashchir, shello tippasel. amar rabbi yehoshua, lo shamati ella shelashit. amru lo, ma hallashon shelashit. amar lahem, kach shamati setam. amar ben azzay, ani afaresh. im omer atta, shelishit, laacherot beminyan. uchesheatta omer, shelashit, bat shalosh shanim. kayyotze vo amru, kerem revai. amru lo, ma hallashon revai. amar lahem, kach shamati setam. amar ben azzay, ani afaresh. im omer atta, revii, laacherim beminyan. uchesheatta omer, revai, ben arba shanim. kayyotze vo amru, haochel bevayit hamenugga peras, mishshalosh lekav. amru lo, emor mishshemone esre lisa. amar lahem, kach shamati setam. amar ben azzay, ani afaresh. im omer atta mishshalosh lekav, en bo challa. uchesheatta omer, mishshemone esre lisa, miatattu challato:
1.2: Rabbi yose haggelili omer, parim, bene shetayim, shenneemar (Bamidbar 8), ufar sheni ven bakar tikkach lechattat. vachachamim omrim, af bene shalosh. rabbi meir omer, af bene arba uvene chamesh kesherim, ella sheen meviim zekenim, mippene hakkavod:
1.3: Kevasim, bene shana. veelim, bene shetayim. vechullam miyyom leyom. ben shelosha asar chodesh eno chasher lo leayil velo lecheves. rabbi tarfon korehu palgas. ben azzay korehu noked. rabbi yishmael korehu parchadigma. hikrivo, mevi alav niske ayil, velo ala lo mizzivcho. ben shelosha asar chodesh veyom echad, hare ze ayil:
1.4: Chattot hatztzibbur veolotehen, chattat hayyachid vaasham nazir vaasham metzora, kesherin miyyom sheloshim vahala, veaf beyom sheloshim. veim hikrivum beyom shemini, kesherim. nedarim unedavot, habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach, kesherim miyyom hashshemini vahala, veaf bayyom hashshemini:

2.1: Rabbi eliezer omer, parat chattat hameubberet, keshera. vachachamim poslin. rabbi eliezer omer, enah nilkachat min hannachrim. vachachamim machshirim. velo zo vilvad, ella chol karbenot hatztzibbur vehayyachid bain mehaaretz umichutz laaretz, min hechadash umin hayyashan, chutz min haomer ushete hallechem sheenan bain ella min hechadash umin haaretz:
2.2: Para shekkarneha utelafeha shechorim, yagod. galgal haayin vehashshinnayim vehallashon enam poslim bappara. vehannanneset, keshera. hayta vah yabbelet vachatachah, rabbi yehuda fosel. rabbi shimon omer, kol mekom shennittal velo heela mekomo sear adom, pesula:
2.3: Yotze dofen veetnan umechir, pesula. rabbi eliezer machshir, shenneemar (Devarim 23), lo tavi etnan zona umechir kelev bet Adonai elohecha, veen zo vaa labbayit. kol hammumim happoslim bammukdashim, poslim bappara. rachav aleha, nishan aleha, nitla viznavah, avar bah et hannahar, kippel aleha et hammosera, natan tallito aleha, pesula. aval kesharah bammosera, asa lah sandal bishvil shello tachalik, paras tallito aleha mippene hazzevuvim, keshera. ze hakkelal, kol shehu letzarkah, keshera. letzorech acher, pesula:
2.4: Shachan aleha of, keshera. ala aleha zachar, pesula. rabbi yehuda omer, im heelahu, pesula. veim meatzmo, keshera:
2.5: Hayu vah shete searot shechorot o levanot betoch gumma achat, pesula. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu vetoch kos echad. hayu vetoch shene chosot vehen mochichot zo et zo, pesula. rabbi akiva omer, afillu arba, afillu chamesh, vehen mefuzzarot, yitlosh. rabbi eliezer omer, afillu chamishshim. rabbi yehoshua ben betera omer, afillu achat beroshah veachat biznavah, pesula. hayu vah shete searot, ikkaran mashchir veroshan madim, ikkaran madim veroshan mashchir, hakkol holech achar hannire, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, achar haikkar:

3.1: Shivat yamim kodem lisrefat happara mafrishin kohen hassoref et happara mibbeto lallishka sheal pene habbira, tzafona mizracha, uvet even hayta nikret, umazzin alav kol shivat hayyamim mikkol chattaot shehayu sham. rabbi yose omer, lo hayu mazzin alav ella vashshelishi uvashshevii bilvad. rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, al hakkohen hassoref et happara, mazzin kol shivat hayyamim. veal shel yom hakkippurim, lo hayu mazzin alav ella vashshelishi uvashshevii bilvad:
3.2: Chatzerot hayu virushalayim benuyot al gabbe sela vetachtehem chalul, mippene kever hattehom. umeviim nashim ubbarot veyoldot sham umegaddelot sham et benehen. umeviim shevarim veal gabbehen delatot, vetinokot yoshvin al gabbehen vechosot shel even beyadam. higgiu lashshilloach, yardu umilum, vealu veyashvu al gabbehen. rabbi yose omer, mimmekomo haya meshalshel umemalle:
3.3: Bau lehar habbayit veyardu. har habbayit vehaazarot, tachtehem chalul, mippene kever hattehom. uvefetach haazara haya metukkan kalal shel chattat, umeviin zachar shel rechelim vekoshrim chevel ben karnav, vekoshrim makkel umesabbech berosho shel chevel, vezorko letoch hakkalal, umakke et hazzachar venirta laachorav, venotel umekaddesh, kede sheyyerae al pene hammayim. rabbi yose omer, al tittenu makom latztzedokim lirdot, ella hu notel umekaddesh:
3.4: Lo hayu osin, lo chattat al gabbe chattat, velo tinok al gabbe chavero. utzerichin hayu hattinokot lehazzot, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer, lo hayu tzerichin lehazzot:
3.5: Lo matzu mishsheva, osin mishshesh, mechamesh, mearba, mishshalosh, mishshetayim umeechat. umi asaam. harishona asa moshe, vehashsheniyya asa ezra, vechamesh, meezra vaelach, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, sheva meezra vaelach. umi asaan. shimon hatztzaddik veyochanan kohen gadol asu shetayim shetayim, elyehoenay ben hakkof vachanamel hammitzri veyishmael ben piavi asu achat echat:
3.6: Vechevesh hayu osim mehar habbayit lehar hammishcha, kippin al gabbe chippin, vechippa cheneged haotem, mippene kever hattehom, shebbo chohen hassoref et happara, ufara vechol mesaadeha, yotzin lehar hammishcha:
3.7: Lo hayta fara rotza latzet, en motziin immah shechora, shello yomru, shechora shachatu. velo adumma, shello yomru, shetayim shachatu. rabbi yose omer, lo mishshum ze, ella mishshum shenneemar (Bamidbar 19), vehotzi otah, levaddah. vezikne yisrael hayu makdimim beraglehem lehar hammishcha, uvet tevila haya sham. umetammeim hayu et hakkohen hassoref et happara, mippene hatztzedokim, shello yihyu omrim, bimorve shemesh hayta naaset:
3.8: Samchu yedehem alav veamru lo, ishi kohen gadol, tevol echat. yarad vetaval veala venistappeg. veetzim hayu mesuddarim sham, atze arazim vooranim uveroshim vaatze teena chalaka. veosin otah kemin migdal, umefattechin bah challonot, vachazitah maarava:
3.9: Kefatuha vechevel shel megeg unetanuha al gav hammaaracha, roshah baddarom ufaneha lammaarav. hakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav. shachat bimino vekibbel bismolo. rabbi yehuda omer, bimino haya mekabbel venoten lismolo, umazze vimino. taval vehizza sheva peamim keneged bet kodesh hakkodashim. al kol hazzaya, tevila. gamar millehazzot, kinnach et yado begufah shel para. yarad vehitztzit et haesh baalitot. rabbi akiva omer, bachariyyot:
3.10: Nivkea, veamad chutz miggittah. natal etz erez veezov usheni tolaat. amar lahen, etz erez ze, etz erez ze. ezov ze, ezov ze. sheni tolaat ze, sheni tolaat ze. shalosh peamim al kol davar vedavar. vehem omrim lo, hen vehen, shalosh peamim al kol davar vedavar:
3.11: Kerachan bishyare hallashon vehishlich letoch serefatah. nisrefa, chovtin otah bemaklot, vechovrin otah bichvarot. rabbi yishmael omer, bemakkavot shel even uvichvarot shel even hayta naaset. shachor sheyyesh bo efer, kotshin oto. vesheen bo, mannichin oto. haetzem, ben kach uven kach haya nichtash. vecholkim oto lishlosha chalakim, echad nittan bachel, veechad nittan behar hammishcha, veechad haya mitchallek lechol hammishmarot:

4.1: Parat chattat sheshshechatah shello lishmah, kibbel vehizza shello lishmah, o lishmah veshello lishmah, o shello lishmah velishmah, pesula. rabbi eliezer machshir. veshello rechutz yadayim veraglayim, pesula. rabbi eliezer machshir. veshello vechohen gadol, pesula. rabbi yehuda machshir. umechussar begadim, pesula. uvichle lavan hayta naaset:
4.2: Serafah chutz miggittah, o vishte gittot, o shessaraf shetayim begat achat, pesula. hizza velo chivven keneged happetach, pesula. hizza mishshishshit sheviit, chazar vehizza sheviit, pesula. mishsheviit sheminit vechazar vehizza sheminit, keshera:
4.3: Serafah shello veetzim, o vechol etzim, afillu vekash o vigvava, keshera. hifshitah venittechah, keshera. shechatah al menat leechol mibbesarah velishtot middamah, keshera. rabbi eliezer omer, en machashava foselet bappara:
4.4: Kol haasukin bappara mittechilla vead sof, metammein begadim, ufoslim otah bimlacha. era bah pesul bishchitatah, enah metammea vegadim. era bah behazzayatah, kol haosek bah lifne fesulah, metammea vegadim. leachar pesulah, enah metammea vegadim. nimtzea chumrah, kullah. leolam moalim bah, umarbin lah etzim, umaaseha vayyom, uvechohen, hammelacha foselet bah, ad shettease efer, vehammelacha foselet bammayim, ad sheyyattilu et haefer:

5.1: Hammevi keli cheres lechattat, tovel velan al hakkivshan. rabbi yehuda omer, af min habbayit hu mevi vechasher, shehakkol neemanim al hachattat. uvatteruma, poteach et hakkivshan venotel. rabbi shimon omer, min hasseder hashsheni. rabbi yose omer, min hasseder hashshelishi:
5.2: Hammatbil keli lechattat bemayim sheenam reuyim lekaddesh, tzarich lenaggev. bemayim shehem reuyim lekaddesh, eno tzarich lenaggev. im lehosif letocho mayim mekuddashin, ben kach uven kach tzarich lenaggev:
5.3: Keruya shehitbiluha vemayim sheen reuyin lekaddesh, mekaddeshin bah ad shettitma. nitmea, en mekaddeshin bah. rabbi yehoshua omer, im mekaddesh hu vah battechilla, af bassof yekaddesh bah. im eno mekaddesh bah bassof, af lo vattechilla. ben kach uven kach, lo yosif letochah mayim mekuddashim:
5.4: Shefoferet shechatachah lechattat, rabbi eliezer omer, yatbil miyyad. rabbi yehoshua omer, yetamme veyatbil. hakkol kesherim lekaddesh, chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan, ufosel beishsha uveanderoginos:
5.5: Bechol hakkelim mekaddeshim, afillu vichle gelalim, bichle avanim, uvichle adama. uvisfina, mekaddeshin bah. en mekaddeshin lo vedafnot hakkelim, velo veshule hammachatz, velo vimgufat hechavit, velo vechafnav, mippene sheen memallein veen mekaddeshin veen mazzin me chattat ella vecheli. en matztzilin betzamid patil ella chelim, sheen matztzilim miyyad kele cheres ella chelim:
5.6: Betzat hayyotzrim, keshera. rabbi yose fosel. betzat hattarnegolet, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda machshirin, vachachamim poslin:
5.7: Hashshoket shebbassela, en memallein bah veen mekaddeshin bah veen mazzin mimmenna, veenah tzericha tzamid patil, veenah poselet et hammikve. hayta cheli vechibberah besid, memallein bah umekaddeshin bah umazzin mimmenna, utzericha tzamid patil, ufoselet et hammikve. nikkeva millemattan, ufekakah bismartut, hammayim shebbetochah pesulin, mippene sheenan agullim keli. min hatztzad ufekakah bismartut, hammayim shebbetochah kesherim, mippene shehem agullim keli. asu lah atara shel tit, vehalchu hammayim lesham, pesulin. im haya vari kede sheyyinnatel immah, kesherim:
5.8: Shete shekatot shebbeeven achat, kiddesh achat mehem, hammayim shebbashsheniyya enan mekuddashin. hayu nekuvot zo lazo kishfoferet hannod, o shehayu hammayim tzafin al gabbehen afillu chiklippat hashshum, vekiddesh et achat mehen, hammayim shebbashsheniyya mekuddashin:
5.9: Shete avanim shehikkifan zo lazo vaasaan shoket, vechen shete arevot, vechen hashshoket shennechleka, hammayim shebbenehem enan mekuddashin. asaan besid o vegifsim vehen yecholot lehinnatel keachat, hammayim shebbenehem mekuddashin:

6.1: Hamekaddesh venafal hakkiddush al yado o al hatztzad veachar kach nafal al hashshoket, pasul. nafal min hashshefoferet lashshoket, pasul. natal mishshefoferet vechissa, o shehegif et haddelet, hakkiddush kasher, vehammayim pesulim. zekafah baaretz, pasul. letoch yado, kasher, mippene sheefshar:
6.2: Haya kiddush tzaf al pene hammayim, rabbi meir verabbi shimon omrim, notel umekaddesh. vachachamim omrim, kol shennaga bammayim, en mekaddeshin bo. zalaf et hammayim venimtza kiddush millemattan, rabbi meir verabbi shimon omrim, menaggev umekaddesh. vachachamim omrim, kol shennaga bammayim, en mekaddeshin bo:
6.3: Hamekaddesh bashshoket vehattefi vetochah, af al pi sheppiv tzar kol shehu, hammayim shebbetocho mekuddashin. im haya sefog, hammayim shebbetocho fesulim. ketzad yaase, yezallef ad shehu maggia lassefog. naga bassefog, af al pi shehammayim tzafin al gabbav kol shehen, pesulin:
6.4: Natan yado o raglo o ale yerakot kede sheyyaavru hammayim lechavit, pesulim. ale kanim vaale egoz, kesherim. ze hakkelal, davar shehu mekabbel tuma, pasul. vedavar sheeno mekabbel tuma, kasher:
6.5: Hamefanne et hammayan letoch haggat, o letoch haggevim, pesulim lazzavim velamtzoraim ulekaddesh bahen me chattat, mippene shello nitmalleu vecheli:

7.1: Chamishsha shemmilu chamishsha chaviyyot lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin, venimlechu lekaddeshan kiddush echad, o lekaddeshan kiddush echad venimlechu lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin, hare chullan kesherim. yachid shemmille chamesh chaviyyot lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin, venimlach lekaddeshan kiddush echad, en kasher ella acharon. lekaddeshan kiddush echad venimlach lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin, en kasher ella ze shekkiddesh rishon. amar leechad, kaddesh lecha et ellu, en kasher ella rishon. kaddesh li et ellu, hare chullam kesherim:
7.2: Hamemalle veachat yado veose melacha veachat yado, hamemalle lo uleacher, o shemmille lishnayim keachat, shenehen pesulin, shehammelacha foselet bammilluy, ben lo ben leacher:
7.3: Hamekaddesh beachat yado veose melacha veachat yado, im lo, pasul. veim leacher, kasher. hamekaddesh lo uleacher, shello pasul, veshel acher kasher. hamekaddesh lishnayim keechad, shenehen kesherin:
7.4: Kaddesh li vaakaddesh lach, harishon kasher. malle li vaamalle lach, haacharon kasher. kaddesh li vaamalle lach, shenehem kesherim. malle li vaakaddesh lach, shenehem pesulim:
7.5: Hamemalle lo ulechattat, memalle et shello techilla vekoshro vaesel veachar kach memalle et shel chattat. veim mille shel chattat techilla veachar kach mille et shello, pasul. noten et shello laachorav veet shel chattat lefanav. veim natan et shel chattat laachorav, pasul. hayu shenehen shel chattat, noten echad lefanav veechad laachorav, vechasher, mippene shei efshar:
7.6: Hammolich et hachevel beyado ledarko, kasher. veshello ledarko, pasul. ze halach leyavne shelosha moadot, uvemoed shelishi hichshiru lo horaat shaa:
7.7: Hamechannen et hachevel al yad al yad, kasher. veim kinneno vaacharona, pasul. amar rabbi yose, laze hichshiru horaat shaa:
7.8: Hammatznia et hechavit shello tishshaver, o shekkefaah al piha al menat lenaggevah lemallot bah, kasher. leholich bah et hakkiddush, pasul. hamefanne charasin mittoch hashshoket bishvil shettachazik mayim harebe, kesherin. veim bishvil shello yihyu meakkevin oto veshaa shehu zolef et hammayim, pasul:
7.9: Mi shehayu memav al ketefo vehora horaa, vehera laacherim et hadderech, veharag nachash veakrav, venatal ochalim lehatzeniam, pasul. ochalin leachlan, kasher. hannachash vehaakrav shehayu meakkevim oto, kasher. amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal, kol davar shehu mishshum melacha, ben amad ben lo amad, pasul. davar sheeno mishshum melacha, amad, pasul. veim lo amad, kasher:
7.10: Hammoser memav letame, pesulin. uletahor, kesherin. rabbi eliezer omer, af letame kesherin, im lo asu habbealim melacha:
7.11: Shenayim shehayu memallein lechattat, vehigbihu ze al ze venatal ze laze kotzo, bekiddush echad, kasher. bishne kiddushin, pasul. rabbi yose omer, af bishne kiddushin kasher, im hitnu venehen:
7.12: Happoretz al menat ligdor, kasher. veim gadar, pasul. haochel al menat liktzot, kasher. veim katza, pasul. haya ochel vehotir vezarak ma shebbeyado letachat hatteena o letoch hammuktze bishvil shello yovad, pasul:

8.1: Shenayim shehayu shomrim et hashshoket, nitma achad mehem, kesherim, mippene shehen birshuto shel sheni. tahar, venitma sheni, kesherim, mippene shehen birshuto shel rishon. nitmeu shenehen keachat, pesulin. asa achad mehen melacha, kesherin, mippene shehen birshuto shel sheni. amad, veasa hashsheni melacha, kesherin, mippene shehen birshuto shel rishon. asu shenehen keechad, pesulin:
8.2: Hamekaddesh me chattat, lo yinol et hassandal. sheim naflu mashkin al hassandal, nitma vetimmeahu. hare hu omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani. naflu mashkin al besaro, tahor. naflu al kesuto, nitmet vetimmeattu. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani:
8.3: Hassoref para, ufarim, vehameshalleach et hassair, metamme vegadim. para ufarim vesair hammishtalleach atzman en metammein begadim. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani:
8.4: Haochel minnivlat haof hattahor vehi bevet habbelia, metamme vegadim. hannevela atzmah enah metammea vegadim. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni, veatta timmetani:
8.5: Kol velad hattumot eno metamme chelim, ella mashke. nitma mashke, timmean. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani:
8.6: En keli cheres metamme chavero, ella mashke. nitma mashke, timmeattu. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani:
8.7: Kol happosel et hatteruma, metamme et hammashkin lihyot techilla letamme echad velifsol echad, chutz mittevul yom. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani:
8.8: Kol hayyammim kemikve, shenneemar (Bereshit 1), ulemikve hammayim kara yammim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, hayyam haggadol kemikve, lo neemar yammim, ella sheyyesh bo mine yammim harebe. rabbi yose omer, kol hayyammim metaharin bezochalin, ufesulin lazzavim velamtzoraim ulekaddesh mehen me chattat:
8.9: Hammayim hammukkim, pesulim. ellu hen hammukkim, hammeluchim vehapposhrim. hammayim hamechazzevim, pesulin. ellu hem hammayim hamechazzevim, hamechazzevim echad bashshavua. hamechazzevim befulmesayot uvishne vitztzaron, kesherim. rabbi yehuda fosel:
8.10: Me karmeyon ume fuga, pesulin, mippene shehem me vitztzim. me hayyarden ume yarmuch, pesulim, mippene shehem me taarovot. veelu hen me taarovot, echad kasher veechad pasul, shennitarvu. shenehen kesherin venitarvu, kesherin. rabbi yehuda fosel:
8.11: Beer achav umearat pamyas, keshera. hammayim shennishtannu veshinnuyan mechamat atzman, kesherin. ammat hammayim habbaa merachok, keshera, uvilvad sheyyishmerenna shello yafsikenna adam. rabbi yehuda omer, hare hi vechezkat mutteret. beer shennafal letochah charsit o adama, yamtin lah ad shettitztzal, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer, eno tzarich lehametin:

9.1: Tzelochit shennafal letochah mayim kol shehen, rabbi eliezer omer, yazze shete hazzayot. vachachamim poslin. yarad letochah tal, rabbi eliezer omer, yannichenna vachamma vehattal ole. vachachamim poslin. nafal letochah mashkin ume ferot, yeare vetzarich lenaggev. deyo, komos, vekankantom, vechol davar shehu roshem, yeare veeno tzarich lenaggev:
9.2: Nafal letochah shekatzim uremasim venitbakkeu, o shennishtannu marehem, pesulin. chippushit, ben kach uven kach poselet, mippene shehi chishfoferet. rabbi shimon verabbi eliezer ben yaakov omrim, haddira vehakkinna shebbattevua kesherim, mippene sheen bahem lecha:
9.3: Shatat mehen behema o chayya, pesulin. kol haofot poslin, chutz min hayyona, mippene shehi motzetzet. kol hashsheratzim enam poslin, chutz min hachulda, mippene shehi malleket. rabban gamliel omer, af hannachash, mippene shehi mekia. rabbi eliezer omer, af haachbar:
9.4: Hachoshev al me chattat lishtot, rabbi eliezer omer, pasul. rabbi yehoshua omer, kesheyyatte. amar rabbi yose, bamme devarim amurim, bemayim sheenam mekuddashim. aval bemayim hamekuddashin, rabbi eliezer omer, kesheyyatte. rabbi yehoshua omer, kesheyyishte. veim girger, kasher:
9.5: Me chattat shennifselu, lo yegabbelem betit, shello yaasem takkala laacherim. rabbi yehuda omer, batlu. para sheshshatat me chattat, besarah tame meet leet. rabbi yehuda omer, batlu vemeeha:
9.6: Me chattat veefer chattat, lo yaavirem benahar uvisfina, velo yeshitem al pene hammayim, velo yaamod betzad ze veyizrekem letzad ze. aval over hu vammayim ad tzavvaro. over hu hattahor lechattat uveyadav keli rekam hattahor lechattat, uvemayim sheenam mekuddashin:
9.7: Efer kasher shennitarev beefer mikle, holchin achar harov letamme, veen mekaddeshin bo. rabbi eliezer omer, mekaddeshin bechullan:
9.8: Me chattat shennifselu, metammein et hattahor litruma, veyadav uvegufo. veet hattahor lechattat, lo veyadav velo vegufo. nitmeu, metammeim et hattahor litruma veyadav uvegufo. veet hattahor lechattat, beyadav, aval lo vegufo:
9.9: Efer kasher shennetano al gabbe hammayim sheenan reuyin lekaddesh, metammein et hattahor litruma, beyadav uvegufo. et hattahor lechattat, lo veyadav velo vegufo:

10.1: Kol harauy littamme midras, maddaf lechattat, ben tame ben tahor. veadam, kayyotze vo. kol harauy littamme teme met, ben tame ben tahor, rabbi eliezer omer, eno maddaf. rabbi yehoshua omer, maddaf. vachachamim omrim, hattame, maddaf. vehattahor, eno maddaf:
10.2: Hattahor lechattat shennaga bemaddaf, tame. lagin shel chattat shennaga bemaddaf, tame. hattahor lechattat shennaga beochalim umashkim, beyado, tame. uveraglo, tahor. hesitan beyado, rabbi yehoshua metamme, vachachamim metaharim:
10.3: Kalal shel chattat shennaga besheretz, tahor. netano al gabbav, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammeim. naga beochalim umashkin uvechitve hakkodesh, tahor. netano al gabbehen, rabbi yose metaher, vachachamim metammeim:
10.4: Hattahor lechattat shennaga betannur, beyado, tame. uveraglo, tahor. haya omed al gabbe tannur ufashat yado chutz lattannur, vehallagin betocho, vechen haesel shehu natun al gabbe hattannur uvo shene kelalot, echad mikkan veechad mikkan, rabbi akiva metaher, vachachamim metammein:
10.5: Haya omed chutz lattannur ufashat yadav lachallon venatal et hallagin veheeviro al gabbe hattannur, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin. aval omed hu hattahor lechattat al gabbe tannur uveyado keli rekan hattahor lechattat, uvemayim sheen mekuddashin:
10.6: Lagin shel chattat shennaga beshel kodesh veshel teruma, shel chattat, tame. veshel kodesh veshel teruma, tehorin. shenehen bishte yadav, shenehen temeim. shenehem bishne neyarot, shenehem tehorim. shel chattat binyar veshel teruma beyado, shenehen temein. shel teruma binyar veshel chattat beyado, shenehen tehorin. rabbi yehoshua omer, shel chattat, tame. hayu netunin al gabbe haaretz venaga bahem, shel chattat, tame. shel kodesh veshel teruma, tehorim. hesitan, rabbi yehoshua metamme, vachachamim metaharin:

11.1: Tzelochit shehinnichah megulla, uva umetzaah mechussa, pesula. hinnichah mechussa uva umetzaah megulla, im yechola hachulda lishtot hemenna, o nachash ledivre rabban gamliel, o sheyyarad bah tal ballayla, pesula. hachattat enah nitztzola betzamid patil. umayim sheenan mekuddashin nitztzolin betzamid patil:
11.2: Kol hassefek tahor litruma, tahor lechattat. kol hattaluy litruma, nishpach lechattat. im asu al gabbav tohorot, teluyot. harfafot, tehorot lekodesh velitruma ulechattat. rabbi eliezer omer, haradot, temeot lechattat:
11.3: Devela shel teruma shennafla letoch me chattat unetalah vaachalah, im yesh bah kabbetza, ben temea ben tehora, hammayim temein, vehaochlah chayyav mita. en bah kabbetza, hammayim tehorin, vehaochlah chayyav mita. rabbi yose omer, bithora, hammayim tehorim. hattahor lechattat shehichnis rosho verubbo letoch me chattat, nitma:
11.4: Kol hattaun biat mayim middivre tora, metamme et hakkodesh veet hatteruma veet hachullin veet hammaaser, veasur al biat hammikdash. leachar biato, metamme et hakkodesh, ufosel et hatteruma, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, posel bakkodesh uvatteruma, umuttar bachullin uvammaaser. veim ba el hammikdash, ben lifne viato ben leachar biato, chayyav:
11.5: Kol hattaun biat mayim middivre sofrim, metamme et hakkodesh, ufosel et hatteruma, umuttar bachullin uvammaaser, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim osrim bammaaser. leachar biato, muttar bechullan. veim ba el hammikdash, ben lifne viato uven leachar biato, patur:
11.6: Kol hattaun biat mayim, ben middivre tora ben middivre sofrim, metamme et me chattat veet efer chattat veet hammazze me chattat, bemagga uvemassa. haezov hammuchshar, vehammayim sheenan mekuddashim, ucheli rekam hattahor lechattat, bemagga uvemassa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bemagga aval lo vemassa:
11.7: Kol ezov sheyyesh lo shem levay, pasul. ezov ze, kasher. ezov yavan, ezov kochalit, ezov romi, ezov midbari, pasul. veshel teruma temea, pasul. veshel tehora, lo yazze. veim hizza, kasher. en mazzin lo veyonkot, velo vitmarot. en chayyavin al hayyonkot al biat hammikdash. rabbi eliezer omer, af lo al hattemarot. ellu hen hayyonkot, givolin shello gamalu:
11.8: Ezov shehizza vo, kasher letaher bo et hammetzora. likketo leetzim venaflu alav mashkin, menaggevo vehu chasher. likketo leochalin venaflu alav mashkin, af al pi shenniggevo, pasul. likketo lechattat, kimlukkat leochalin, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim, kimlukkat leetzim:
11.9: Mitzvat ezov, shelosha kelachim uvahem shelosha givolin. rabbi yehuda omer, shel shelosha shelosha. ezov sheyyesh bo shelosha kelachim, mefassego veogdo. pissego velo agado, agado velo fissego, lo fissego velo agado, kasher. rabbi yose omer, mitzvat ezov, shelosha kelachim, uvahem shelosha givolim, usheyarav shenayim, vegardummav kol shehu:

12.1: Haezov hakkatzar, mesappeko vechut uvechush, vetovel umaale, veochez baezov umazze. rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim, keshem shehazzaya vaezov, kach tevila vaezov:
12.2: Hizza, safek min hachut, safek min hakkush, safek min haggivol, hazzayato fesula. hizza al shene chelim, safek al shenehem hizza, safek mechavero mitztza alav, hazzayato fesula. machat shehi netuna al hacheres, vehizza aleha, safek al hammachat hizza, safek min hacheres mitztza aleha, hazzayato fesula. tzelochit sheppiha tzar, tovel umaale chedarko. rabbi yehuda omer, hazzaya rishona. me chattat shennitmaatu, tovel afillu rashe givolin umazze, uvilvad shello yesappeg. nitkavven lehazzot lefanav vehizza leacharav, leacharav vehizza lefanav, hazzayato fesula. lefanav, vehizza al hatztzedadin shellefanav, hazzayato cheshera. mazzin al haadam middato veshello middato. mazzin al haadam veal hakkelim, vaafillu hen mea:
12.3: Nitkavven lehazzot al davar shehu mekabbel tuma vehizza al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma, im yesh baezov, lo yishne. al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma, vehizza al davar shemmekabbel tuma, im yesh baezov, yishne. al haadam, vehizza al habbehema, im yesh baezov, lo yishne. al habbehema, vehizza al haadam, im yesh baezov, yishne. hammayim hamenattefim, kesherim. lefichach hem metammein leshem me chattat:
12.4: Hammazze mechallon shel rabbim venichnas lammikdash venimtzeu hammayim pesulim, patur. mechallon shel yachid venichnas lammikdash venimtzeu hammayim pesulin, chayyav. aval kohen gadol, ben mechallon shel yachid ben mechallon shel rabbim, patur, sheen kohen gadol chayyav al biat hammikdash. machalikin hayu lifne challon shel rabbim vedorsin velo nimnain, mippene sheamru, me chattat sheasu mitzvatan, enan metammein:
12.5: Ochez hu hattahor bakkardom hattame bichnafo, umazze alav. af al pi sheyyesh alav kede hazzaya, tahor. kamma yehe vammayim veyihye vahem kede hazzaya. kede sheyyatbil rashe givolin veyazze. rabbi yehuda omer, roim otam keillu hen al ezov shel nechoshet:
12.6: Hammazze veezov tame, im yesh bo chabbetza, hammayim pesulim, vehazzayato fesula. en bo chabbetza, hammayim kesherim, vehazzayato fesula. umetamme et chavero, vachavero et chavero, afillu hen mea:
12.7: Hattahor lechattat shennitmeu yadav, nitma gufo, umetamme et chavero, vachavero et chavero, afillu hen mea:
12.8: Lagin shel chattat shennitmeu achorav, nitma tocho, umetamme et chavero, vachavero et chavero, afillu hen mea. hazzog vehainbal, chibbur. kush shel rovan, lo yazze lo al hakkush velo al happika. veim hizza, muzze. shel pishtan, chibbur. or shel arisa shehu mechubbar lappikot, chibbur. hammalben, eno chibbur lo letuma velo letohora. kol yedot hakkelim hakkeduchot, chibbur. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, af hacharukot:
12.9: Hassallim shebbakkantal, vehammitta shel tarbal, vekeren shel keliva, ukeranin shel yotze derachim, veshalshelet hammaftechot, ushelal hakkovsim, vehabbeged shehu tafur bechilayim, chibbur lattuma veeno chibbur lahazzaya:
12.10: Kissuy mecham shehu mechubbar leshalshelet, bet shammay omrim, chibbur lattuma veeno chibbur lahazzaya. bet hillel omrim, hizza al hammecham, huzza hakkissuy. hizza al hakkissuy, lo huzza hammecham. hakkol kesherim lehazzot, chutz mittumtum veanderoginos vehaishsha. vetinok sheen bo daat, haishsha mesaadto umazze, veochezet lo vammayim vehu tovel umazze. im achaza veyado, afillu vishat hazzaya, pasul:
12.11: Taval et haezov bayyom vehizza vayyom, kasher. bayyom vehizza vallayla, ballayla vehizza vayyom, pasul. aval hu atzmo tovel ballayla umazze vayyom, sheen mazzin ad shettanetz hachamma. vechullan sheasu mishsheala ammud hashshachar, kasher:
